skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the role of controlled and uncontrolled information in PR activities.
Master writing skills for various media types in PR, especially for journalism.
Understand the PR writing process and have written communication skills.
Develop writing skills for various media types used in PR activities.
Learn to write for specific public relations audiences.
Master the art of writing emails for public relations purposes.
Learn to write effective memos for public relations.
Develop skills to write reports and proposals for public relations.
Learn to write for websites in the context of public relations.
Master writing for social media platforms in public relations.
Learn to write press releases for print and broadcast media.
Develop skills to write speeches for public relations events.
Learn event management techniques for public relations.
Understand crisis management principles in public relations.
Learn fundraising management techniques for public relations.
Select appropriate textbooks and materials for public relations studies.
Develop critical thinking skills to analyze public relations issues.
Work collaboratively with peers on public relations projects.
Develop self-directed learning skills for continuous improvement in public relations.
